p1_findings.finding: The r1 local alias chain is fixed, but owner=self attribute aliases and self.helper call bodies remain opaque. The exact forward's self.act callees are pure only by manual pinned-source review.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Track self aliases, recursively inspect allowlisted callees, and freeze all ordinary output-path configuration attributes in the deployment manifest.

p1_findings.finding: Key work_empty/release/phase-zero fragments are pinned, but the analyzer does not exhaustively parse ports or all overwrite-before-valid relationships.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Encode a complete register liveness/overwrite table or bind release-to-next-context SVA.

p1_findings.finding: The result identity omits the r2 analyzer and audit contract. M289/M302 files are exact-SHA pinned, but the analyzer does not parse the M289 input RTL relation or execute their nested seal checks.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Add analyzer/contract identities to result and explicitly check the input relation plus M289/M302 member and outer seals.

paper_safe_statement: Under an explicit deployment contract—not a runtime-compliance measurement—requiring calibration hooks absent, autograd and training-time threshold and optimizer updates disabled, and parameters, buffers, and output-path configuration frozen, the pinned ATLIF forward maps each complete temporal tile independently. The exact M273 T10 RTL accepts release only after all live ownership, pipeline, and result-FIFO state drains; stale physical bits remain unobservable and are overwritten before valid reuse. Thus this standalone boundary requires no spatially indexed or cross-frame membrane-state SRAM. The exact-source M289 logic-only netlist contains 9,639 one-bit sequential standard-cell cells and zero macros; T2 RTL, network-wide weight/config and activation storage, Fixed comparison, trained rank-3 accuracy, power, energy, and system performance remain outside this claim.

decision.next_action: Use only the conditional paper sentence; optionally close the three P1 robustness items in the next static analyzer revision.
